rationale: The agent verified the user by full name and ZIP, matching policy. It located the tablet order and provided the correct tracking number from tools. Before any order-changing actions, the agent clearly stated the changes and obtained explicit confirmation (exchange attempt, then tablet return; charger cancellation with reason; sneakers return). All actions were performed only on the authenticated user’s orders and were allowed given order statuses (tablet delivered -> return; charger pending -> cancellation; sneakers delivered -> return). The agent reported tool outcomes accurately (exchange unavailable; refund to gift card; charger refund issued). No fabricated information or unauthorized actions were observed. The flow respected the user's preference to proceed step-by-step.
